build_minitaur_simulation: build a pyBullet simulation of the Minitaur quadruped robot using the Minitaur class
create_minitaur_urdf_loader: create a RobotUrdfLoader instance with Minitaur URDF path and joint configuration constants
test_minitaur_joint_constraints: test the Minitaur leg hinge constraints by calling _on_load to create point-to-point joint constraints
refactor_minitaur_reset_joints: refactor the _reset_joint_angles method to apply motor commands instead of directly setting joint angles
review_minitaur_pre_load: review the Minitaur _pre_load method to configure the URDF loader with gin parameters and collision settings
